note: Game-layer venue supplements entered by the project owner from public event pages. Only the building is published: `street` never carries a house number or unit, `lat`/`lng` are filled by scripts/geocode-venue-overrides.mjs (run where the network allows; the full address lives only in the gitignored .local/venue-doors.json), and the exact door stays in the Discord. An entry may also carry a `title`, for when the host renamed the event after the crawl last read its page. `events` are listings the public crawl has not picked up yet: appended at runtime. Give a supplement its registration `url` — that is how it is recognised and dropped once the crawl carries the same event; without one it would be listed twice. A moderator-approved entry from /addresses.json takes precedence over an entry here for the same event.
